_comment: EXAMPLE Claude Code hook: format edited Python files with ruff. Merge into the project's .claude/settings.json under "hooks". Adjust the event name / matcher / env var to your Claude Code version before relying on it.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.py) uv run ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac
